biotools.summary: Simple and efficient workflow for time-course gene expression data, built on publictly available open-source projects hosted on CRAN and bioconductor. moanin provides helper functions for all the steps required for analysing time-course data using functional data analysis: (1) functional modeling of the timecourse data; (2) differential expression analysis; (3) clustering; (4) downstream analysis.
